description: This file defines data structures related to call stack information and post-mortem data for the WPEFramework PluginHost component. It includes classes for representing call stack entries and aggregating post-mortem data, with JSON serialization support.

classes.name: CallstackData
classes.description: Represents individual call stack frame data including address, function name, module, and line number.

classes.name: PostMortemData
classes.description: Aggregates multiple call stacks and associated worker pool metadata for post-mortem analysis.

classes.name: PostMortemData::Callstack
classes.description: Represents a single call stack with an ID and a list of call stack frames.

methods.name: CallstackData()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing JSON container and adding fields.

methods.name: CallstackData(const Core::callstack_info& source)
methods.description: Constructs CallstackData from a callstack_info source, converting address and copying other fields.

methods.name: PostMortemData()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing JSON container and adding worker pool and callstacks.
